scripts.name: Removed
scripts.script: let Source = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#table({"Region","Product","Units","Price","Day"}, {{"North","Pen","2","1.5","2024-01-15"},{"South","Pen","5","1.5","2024-01-20"},{"North","Ink","1","12","2024-02-03"},{"East","Pad","10","0.75","2024-02-29"},{"South","Ink","3","12","2024-03-01"}}), {{"Region", type text}, {"Product", type text}, {"Units", Int64.Type}, {"Price", type number}, {"Day", type date}}), Removed = Table.RemoveColumns(Source, {"Price", "Day"}) in Removed

scripts.name: Index
scripts.script: let Source = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#table({"Region","Product","Units","Price","Day"}, {{"North","Pen","2","1.5","2024-01-15"},{"South","Pen","5","1.5","2024-01-20"},{"North","Ink","1","12","2024-02-03"},{"East","Pad","10","0.75","2024-02-29"},{"South","Ink","3","12","2024-03-01"}}), {{"Region", type text}, {"Product", type text}, {"Units", Int64.Type}, {"Price", type number}, {"Day", type date}}), Index = Table.AddIndexColumn(Source, "Idx", 1, 1, Int64.Type) in Index

scripts.name: Rank
scripts.script: let Source = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#table({"Region","Product","Units","Price","Day"}, {{"North","Pen","2","1.5","2024-01-15"},{"South","Pen","5","1.5","2024-01-20"},{"North","Ink","1","12","2024-02-03"},{"East","Pad","10","0.75","2024-02-29"},{"South","Ink","3","12","2024-03-01"}}), {{"Region", type text}, {"Product", type text}, {"Units", Int64.Type}, {"Price", type number}, {"Day", type date}}), Rank = Table.AddColumn(Source, "Big", each if [Price] > 5 then "High" else "Low", type text) in Rank

scripts.name: Running
scripts.script: let Source = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#table({"Region","Product","Units","Price","Day"}, {{"North","Pen","2","1.5","2024-01-15"},{"South","Pen","5","1.5","2024-01-20"},{"North","Ink","1","12","2024-02-03"},{"East","Pad","10","0.75","2024-02-29"},{"South","Ink","3","12","2024-03-01"}}), {{"Region", type text}, {"Product", type text}, {"Units", Int64.Type}, {"Price", type number}, {"Day", type date}}), Running = Table.AddColumn(Table.AddIndexColumn(Source, "i", 0), "Cum", (r) => List.Sum(List.FirstN(Source[Units], r[i] + 1)), type number) in Running

scripts.name: Keep
scripts.script: let Source = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#table({"Region","Product","Units","Price","Day"}, {{"North","Pen","2","1.5","2024-01-15"},{"South","Pen","5","1.5","2024-01-20"},{"North","Ink","1","12","2024-02-03"},{"East","Pad","10","0.75","2024-02-29"},{"South","Ink","3","12","2024-03-01"}}), {{"Region", type text}, {"Product", type text}, {"Units", Int64.Type}, {"Price", type number}, {"Day", type date}}), Keep = Table.SelectColumns(Table.SelectRows(Source, each [Region] <> "East"), {"Region", "Units"}) in Keep
